segments.en: No, no, that's Dinesh, my name is Gautam.
I don't know, in the app, in the ID, it shows like that.
Okay, okay, I am married too.
I couldn't tell from your voice, so I asked.
Okay, okay, do they go to school?
The elder one is in LKG, the younger one is two years old.
I shifted here five months ago.
Okay, where in Salem are you?
I am two years older than you.
Leave it, it's okay, let it be, what does it matter?
Should I not talk, or is 31 not okay?
If you want to tell, tell me.
Your voice is good, thank you.
No, you were asking something, tell me, I asked in between, sorry.
I didn't ask anything, where is your wife?
Okay, has she gone to her hometown?
That's why you came here to be alone, right?
More than me, you are the one who is alone.
Why are you saying that? Oh, I have come permanently, right?
How many kids do you have?
Only one girl, three years old.
It's been three or four years since you got married, right?
At this time, you are speaking very clearly, I can hear your voice.
What are you doing? Are you not sleeping?
No, no, I am just keeping the phone near my mouth and talking.
Are you with your in-laws, or are you staying separately?
I don't have in-laws, both of them have passed away.
How are you staying alone without anyone?
I didn't take a room, I took a house.
Okay, okay, you took a house.
I have my own house here, my mother's house is nearby, I have my own house.
I have some construction work, I have to finish the pending work.
So, until then, I am staying in a rented house, they are all supporting me.
That's what I asked, how are you staying without anyone's support?
It's not like that, they are all there, my mother, grandfather, grandmother, mother, father, my family, aunt's family, brother's family.
Okay, I asked that, then you are alone in Attur, right?
Yes, this is the place where I was born and brought up, actually, it's been ten years since I got married in Chennai.
After ten years, I have come now.
No, for now, there is no work, the kids are small.
How long have you been using this app?
I installed it a long time ago, but I am not a regular user, I come occasionally.
Same here, I only use it when my wife goes out, otherwise I don't come.
Are you scared of your wife?
No, I am not scared, it's just that I don't want unnecessary problems.
She is okay, not too strict, not too liberal, she is okay.
Do you like your wife very much?
I don't like her very much, 70 percent, 30 percent I don't like, we keep fighting.
What did she study? What did you study?
I am a B.E. Mechanical, she is an M.Sc. B.Ed.
So, since you have kids, you don't go to work, right?
It's going on, how about you? How do you like your husband?
My husband and I are not compatible.
From the beginning, it was like that.
His character doesn't suit me, and it doesn't suit anyone else.
I am not saying that just to complain, he is a very, very, very good person, he is a very good human being.
He has a very helpful tendency, he is the best father in this world, the best son, a good disciple to his guru.
But is he a good husband? If you ask, that doesn't come to him.
The way he grew up, there is a lot of age difference between him and me.
The way he grew up, in that generation, women used to live like, no matter what anyone said, they wouldn't answer back.
They would hide behind the door and answer back, like that.
He expects the same thing from me, how is that possible?
It's been so many generations, you are in such a generation, how is that possible?
If I say, 'Hey, give me tea, give me coffee,' then if I say my name and ask for tea, even if I ask ten times, he won't give it.
If I say, 'Hey, give me tea,' he won't do it, he won't do what he doesn't want to do.
That is his nature, that's how he talks, his way of talking, his tone, nothing is for us.
Because I have also studied, I have also studied, I am also a good, what to say, I have lived in better conditions than him, I am a well-educated girl, I am young.
Then why did you marry at this age? It should be like that, right?
That is another issue, leave that.
That is a big issue, then?
Actually, you are talking with a smile even about such a sad thing, it changes so quickly.
That's because I'm used to it.
Because he, I am completely, I have come out of him.
I don't have anything in my mind, because he has hurt me to that extent.
That is, now, how do you know?
I will tell you one, one, one thing, you will understand it completely.
Like, now, at my house in Chennai, people come to clean the house, wash the dishes, they will come and go.
Until then, he will talk to me nicely, he will talk while smiling in the morning.
When I enter before 10 o'clock, he will call me names, he will call me names, he will call me names.
I will ask, 'You were talking nicely until now, why are you doing this?' Not to someone else, I want to insult someone in front of others.
Then, if you want to insult your wife in front of a third person, it means you don't have love for her.
If you really had love for her, you wouldn't do such a thing.
Even if you do, if we talk within ourselves, it's okay.
Yes, yes, I am not wrong, I am not wrong, I have not done anything wrong, I will not do it, really.
Let what I have done be as it is.
Is that what you are saying?
No, has anything like that happened? I am asking if he talks like that.
No, I am asking if anything wrong has happened.
No, I am asking if you did something or he did something.
Yes, he does this a lot.
This is how he treats me, this is how it is.
I have never taken money from his pocket.
He will say as if I have taken it.
Why should I take money from his pocket? He will shout in front of others, in front of his ears.
Why don't you have the sense that taking money from his pocket is not good?
How many times should I tell you not to take money from his pocket? If you touch it, it won't be understood, don't you know?
Okay, okay, okay, he talks like that.
Cool, cool, cool, cool, cool, cool.
How can we be with a person like that?
He will never divorce, he will never give divorce.
No, I am asking openly, there is nothing wrong with this, I am asking you to share it.
Like that, we can be friends, but beyond that, I don't want any other relationship.
If you want, I can tell you directly, there is no harm in that, you tell me if you want to be friends.
Yes, friendship, to be honest, I am a little busy, because I have to pick up and drop the kids, do this and that, and then in the evening I have to take tuition.
No, no, I will tell you, whenever you are free, whenever you feel like talking, you can call me, if you say friendship, it's okay.
The thing is, I don't have time, after that, I will share my ID with you, but I don't have the heart to let you suffer.
No, nothing is needed, just give me your number, I will send a 'Hi' on WhatsApp.
No, I don't want the number, I can give you my Telegram ID.
No, actually, I am telling you, they use WhatsApp, that's why I am telling you, otherwise I can give it, no problem.
Everything, they use WhatsApp and Telegram, I will save it as a company number, that's all, nothing else.
My problem is that, I am a little scared, that's the issue.
No, nothing, just give me your number, I will just say 'Hi', when you are free, you call me, that's all.
Nothing else, you will give it as I said, right?
Yes, we can talk, we can talk, we can talk a little.
Give me some time, I need some time.
No, take your time, please cut it, after you said so much, I felt a bit strange, that's why I asked you to cut it.
You are so hurt, that's why I asked for your number immediately.
I am hurt, but I have come out of it, now I am not hurt.
How to say, it happened like that, it was just, now I am hurt, if you ask if I am hurt, I am not hurt.
Because, now, if I expect something from him, then it will hurt me.
But I am not expecting anything.
What did you eat at night?
When did you sleep? When did you wake up in the morning?
I woke up today, tomorrow, I won't wake up tomorrow, I will tell you.
Cut it and go, don't forget to share the number, please.
But I can't talk, is it okay for you?
No, I will message you, you can call me when you are free, I have no problem.
There will be a photo of the baby.
The message has come, is the DP there?
Yes, I got the number, the DP didn't come.
Wait, I will save it, I have already messaged you.
I haven't shared my number with anyone until now.
I will tell you how to call me, everything in detail on WhatsApp.
I am scared, I have never done this to anyone, this is the first time.
I will not torture you, I will not do anything.
Just one minute, I will call you on that, WhatsApp call, voice call.
Don't do it, don't do it, don't do it.
